name: Master of Disguise
summary: A master of disguise believes that never letting her adversaries know her true identity protects her from bad luck or missteps on a job.

features.name: Consummate Actor (Ex)
features.summary: A master of disguise adds half her rogue level (minimum 1) on all Disguise checks and on Bluff checks to stay in character while using Disguise. At 2nd level, she gains the quick disguise APG rogue talent, and she can create a disguise twice as quickly as normal even for that rogue talent (she can create a disguise that encompasses only minor details as a standard action). This ability replaces trapfinding and the rogue talent gained at 2nd level.

features.name: Grandmaster of Disguise (Ex)
features.summary: At 10th level, a master of disguise gains the master of disguise APG advanced rogue talent and can use it an unlimited number of times per day. Because she must still don a physical disguise to gain this bonus, it doesn’t stack with the bonuses from spells like alter self and disguise self , but since it is completely nonmagical, it is more reliable when scrutinized under magical detection. This ability replaces the rogue talent gained at 10th level.

features.name: Rogue Talents
features.summary: The following rogue talents complement the master of disguise archetype: camouflage APG , false friend ARG , major magic, minor magic, obfuscate story ARG , shades of gray, and steal the story ARG .

features.name: Advanced Talents
features.summary: The following advanced rogue talents complement the master of disguise archetype: hard minded UC , hidden mind, skill mastery, slippery mind, and unwitting ally UC .

mechanicalNotes: Replacement progression is automated. Bespoke effects without a shared builder subsystem remain descriptive.
